name: npm-sbom
description: npm sbom: npm's built-in SBOM generator (CycloneDX or SPDX) for the installed dependency tree.
title: npm-sbom

llmHints.on_match: npm sbom observed. It prints to stdout: redirect to sbom.cdx.json (or *.spdx.json) so the sbom attestor captures it.

positiveSetup: Invoke cilock with argv starting "npm sbom"
negativeSetup: Invoke cilock with unrelated argv (e.g. `echo unrelated`)
